title: FragmentSender exposes mutable security-critical state-machine fields
description: Correctness review: FragmentSender remains a mutable dataclass. Callers can change rule_id after fragments/session binding or mutate attempts/status to bypass retry invariants; vector tests directly assign attempts rather than exercising transitions. Make construction/binding fields immutable and expose read-only status/attempt properties backed by internal transition methods. Drive retry exhaustion tests through real timeout or authenticated ACK events.
